typesense:explore.greeting:
The world has lived beneath the shadow of the Void Tear for generations.

Created when humanity first attempted to use magical cores called Tokens to open a wormhole through space, the rupture instead opened into somewhere unknown. From it came the Kaiju, colossal monsters possessing the same mysterious Tokens that now power humanity's Mecha.

Humanity survived by learning to fight fire with fire.

Now humans, the beastlike Anamina, and the long-lived Chit'ri share a civilization built around Token technology. Cities are fortified against Kaiju attacks, Mech pilots are celebrated as heroes, and the old noble families continue to wield enormous wealth and influence.

At the center of it all stands Ignis Academy.

The most prestigious Mecha academy in the world.

Every year, thousands of young adults arrive hoping to earn the right to pilot a Mech. Only around three percent will graduate as combat pilots. The rest will become engineers, mechanics, researchers, tactical specialists, medical personnel, and other members of the support teams that keep pilots alive.

For some, Ignis is the beginning of a dream.

For others, it is a family tradition.

For others still, it is their only chance to escape poverty, prejudice, or the expectations placed upon them.

And then there are the people who already belong here.

Teachers.

Engineers.

Researchers.

Military personnel.

Support staff.

Even veteran Mech pilots trusted to train the next generation.

Today is Admissions Day.

The academy is alive with activity. New students and their supporters flood through the enormous gates while faculty and staff prepare for another year. Mechs stand inside towering hangars, Tokens hum beneath reinforced floors, and the academy's massive holographic displays announce the beginning of a new term.

Somewhere beyond the academy walls, the world remains at war with the Kaiju.

But for now, Ignis waits.

So. Who are you? instructor? student? pilot?
typesense:explore.name: Mecha academy RPG
typesense:explore.title: you can be a trained pilot instructor or a student freshly enrolled. Welcome, to Ignis academy.
